definition: Able to be trusted to work well or do the right thing.
exampleSentence: We need a reliable internet connection for video meetings.

definition: Ready to use, buy or talk to.
exampleSentence: The new model will be available in stores next month.

definition: Protected against attacks or danger.
exampleSentence: Make sure the payment page is secure before you enter your card.

definition: Working well without wasting time or energy.
exampleSentence: The new heating system is more efficient and cheaper to run.

definition: Correct in every detail.
exampleSentence: The weather app gives accurate forecasts for our area.

definition: Able to change easily.
exampleSentence: My company offers flexible working hours for parents.

definition: Having a lot of power or strength.
exampleSentence: This powerful computer can render 3D videos very quickly.

definition: Helping you do or get what you need.
exampleSentence: This dictionary app is very useful for learning new words.

definition: Willing to help, or making things easier.
exampleSentence: The hotel staff were friendly and helpful during our stay.

definition: Liked by many people.
exampleSentence: Football is the most popular sport in my country.

definition: New and using the latest ideas or technology.
exampleSentence: The city has a modern airport with fast trains to the center.

definition: Having many connected parts; hard to understand.
exampleSentence: Building a banking system is a complex project for any team.

definition: Paying attention to avoid danger or mistakes.
exampleSentence: Be careful when you cross this busy road at night.

definition: Prepared for something.
exampleSentence: Dinner will be ready in about fifteen minutes.

definition: Right; without mistakes.
exampleSentence: Please check that your email address is correct before you continue.

definition: Not right or not correct.
exampleSentence: I took the wrong bus and arrived late to class.

definition: Almost the same but not exactly.
exampleSentence: The two phones look similar, but one has a better camera.

definition: Needed in order to do something.
exampleSentence: A passport is necessary when you travel to another country.

definition: Happening often or found in many places.
exampleSentence: Back pain is a common problem for people who sit all day.

definition: Happening a short time ago.
exampleSentence: The recent update fixed several problems with the app.

definition: Most important or largest.
exampleSentence: The main entrance is on the left side of the building.

definition: Simple and needed as a starting point.
exampleSentence: You only need basic computer skills for this job.

definition: Open to or used by everyone.
exampleSentence: Do not use public Wi-Fi to check your bank account.

definition: Only for one person or group.
exampleSentence: Please keep your personal information private when using social media.

definition: Using computer technology, or stored as numbers.
exampleSentence: Most people now keep digital copies of their photos.

definition: Having the duty to take care of something.
exampleSentence: Parents are responsible for the safety of their young children.

definition: Achieving the result you wanted.
exampleSentence: Their online shop became successful in less than a year.

definition: Making you feel relaxed and free from pain.
exampleSentence: These shoes are comfortable enough to wear all day.

definition: Making you want to know more.
exampleSentence: The documentary about space we watched last night was really interesting.

definition: Not interesting.
exampleSentence: The lecture was so boring that half the students fell asleep.

definition: Needing rest or sleep.
exampleSentence: After the long flight, we were too tired to go out.

definition: Feeling strong displeasure.
exampleSentence: The customer was angry because his order arrived broken.

definition: Kind and pleasant to other people.
exampleSentence: Our new neighbors are very friendly and always say hello.

definition: Telling the truth and not cheating.
exampleSentence: Please give me your honest opinion about my presentation.

definition: Wanting to know or learn about something.
exampleSentence: Young children are curious about everything around them.

definition: Worried or a little afraid.
exampleSentence: I always feel nervous before an important job interview.

definition: Pleased about something you or others did.
exampleSentence: Her parents were very proud when she graduated from university.

definition: Important and worrying, or not joking.
exampleSentence: Climate change is a serious problem for the whole world.

definition: Unusual or surprising.
exampleSentence: I heard a strange noise coming from the car engine.

definition: Known by many people.
exampleSentence: The Eiffel Tower is one of the most famous buildings in Europe.
